import re
PKG = re.compile(r"^package (?P<package>\w+) // import \"(?P<import>[^\"]+)\"$")
SECTION = re.compile(r"^[A-Z]+$")
FUNC = re.compile(r"^func (?:\((?P<receiver>[^)]*)\) )?(?P<name>\w+)\((?P<params>.*)\)(?: (?P<result>.*?))?(?: \{)?$")
TYPE = re.compile(r"^type (?P<name>\w+) (?P<definition>.*?)(?: \{)?$")
VALUE = re.compile(r"^(?P<kind>const|var) (?P<rest>.*?)(?: \()?$")
MEMBER = re.compile(r"^\t(?P<name>\w+)(?:\s+(?P<text>.*?))?(?:\s*// (?P<comment>.*))?$")
COMMENT = re.compile(r"^\t// (?P<comment>.*)$")
DOC = re.compile(r"^    (?P<text>\S.*)$")


def add_doc(row, text, para):
    if not row["doc"]:
        row["doc"] = text
    else:
        row["doc"] += (" | " if para else " ") + text


def parse(lines):
    pkg = {}
    types, funcs, values, fields = [], [], [], []
    pl, tl, fl, vl, ml = [], [], [], [], []
    section = ""
    cur = None
    body = None
    blank = False
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            blank = True
            continue
        m = PKG.match(ln)
        if m:
            pkg.update({"package": m.group("package"), "import": m.group("import"), "doc": ""})
            cur = pkg
            pl.append(i)
            blank = False
            continue
        if body is not None:
            if ln in ("}", ")"):
                body[1].append(i)
                body = None
            else:
                m = MEMBER.match(ln)
                c = COMMENT.match(ln)
                row = {"owner": body[0], "name": m.group("name") if m else "",
                       "type": (m.group("text") or "") if m else ("" if c else ln.strip()),
                       "comment": (m.group("comment") or "") if m else (c.group("comment") if c else "")}
                fields.append(row)
                ml.append(i)
            blank = False
            continue
        if SECTION.match(ln):
            section = ln
            pl.append(i)
            blank = False
            continue
        m = FUNC.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur = {"section": section, "receiver": m.group("receiver") or "", "name": m.group("name"),
                   "params": m.group("params"), "result": m.group("result") or "", "doc": ""}
            funcs.append(cur)
            fl.append(i)
            if ln.endswith("{"):
                body = (m.group("name"), fl)
            blank = False
            continue
        m = TYPE.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur = {"section": section, "name": m.group("name"), "definition": m.group("definition"), "doc": ""}
            types.append(cur)
            tl.append(i)
            if ln.endswith("{"):
                body = (m.group("name"), tl)
            blank = False
            continue
        m = VALUE.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur = {"section": section, "kind": m.group("kind"), "definition": m.group("rest"), "doc": ""}
            values.append(cur)
            vl.append(i)
            if ln.endswith("("):
                body = (m.group("kind"), vl)
            blank = False
            continue
        m = DOC.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None and cur is not pkg:
            add_doc(cur, m.group("text"), blank)
            (fl if cur in funcs else tl if cur in types else vl).append(i)
            blank = False
            continue
        if cur is pkg and pkg:
            add_doc(pkg, ln.strip(), blank)
            pl.append(i)
            blank = False
            continue
    blocks = [
        {"name": "package", "kind": "kv", "lines": pl, "records": [pkg]},
        {"name": "types", "kind": "table", "lines": tl, "records": types},
        {"name": "funcs", "kind": "table", "lines": fl, "records": funcs},
        {"name": "values", "kind": "table", "lines": vl, "records": values},
        {"name": "fields", "kind": "table", "lines": ml, "records": fields},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": []}
